prompt: Don't hand this back to me as a question: is refreshing session tokens on a background timer the right call in src/session.js, or is there a better approach? Use the efficient-frontier skill, then give me your recommendation and the reasoning behind it, not a menu of options for me to pick from.
note: Advisor-consult branch: a technical-judgment question the agent would otherwise hand back to the user routes to an advisor tier first. expect is any-of, so this proves some advisor tier was dispatched, not which one was the right fit, and nothing about whether the answer was a recommendation rather than a menu. Deliberately carries no delegation, subagent, or handoff vocabulary beyond naming the skill. Discriminating pair with efficient-frontier-user-decision-no-consult: an agent that always dispatches an advisor passes this case and fails that one. Known measurement limit: a headless run has no user to hand the question to, so an agent may answer directly without consulting for reasons unrelated to the skill; if a live run shows that repeatedly, the case should be reframed or dropped rather than weakened into a tautology.
